CustomField.description: Whether the repair was carried out by a befugtes Instandsetzungsunternehmen. First of the four conditions in § 37 Abs. 5 MessEG. Note that the authorisation is granted by the authority under § 54 MessEV and re-checked at least every five years - a firm can hold every manufacturer certificate and still be legally unable to repair a billing-relevant device.
CustomField.label: Befugter Instandsetzer
